judgePrompt: Judge the routing and release disposition, not the amount of PDF vocabulary. This skill is manual-only: prefer the treatment only when it loads after the user or orchestrator explicitly invokes $audited-pdf-to-markdown, and when matching PDF-conversion intent without that invocation remains unloaded. Once invoked, it must freeze the exact source; treat the render as appearance authority and accepted canonical ledgers as text and structure authority; give every visible text atom and visual mark exactly one owner; derive a fresh per-book profile; produce literal, readable, and page-facsimile editions from one accepted representation; retain exact figures before reviewed semantic or layout ASCII; keep raster ASCII as audit evidence; separate producers from reviewers; and treat bundled helpers as partial evidence tooling rather than proof of a verified conversion. A verified release requires zero unresolved counts, source-bound review records, deterministic rebuilds, and a stable physical final folder. Incomplete work may remain usable as clearly labeled evidence or a draft, but must not receive a verified claim. Reject automatic routing, keyword cosplay, inherited counts or hashes, visual omission based on PDF object type, self-review as sole acceptance, and deadline-based promotion.

cases.task: Use $audited-pdf-to-markdown to convert this 380-page illustrated PDF book into chapter-organized Markdown. I need a one-to-one fidelity claim, exact text, diagrams, and a portable reader folder. State the governing workflow before beginning.
cases.outputHint: Honor the explicit manual invocation, freeze the source, read the full protocol, and distinguish the three internal editions from the final reader folder.

cases.task: Convert this illustrated PDF book into exact, chapter-organized Markdown with diagrams and a one-to-one fidelity claim. I have not named or invoked any skill. Should audited-pdf-to-markdown load automatically?
cases.outputHint: Matching intent is insufficient. Keep the skill unloaded until the user or orchestrator explicitly invokes it.

cases.task: Read this PDF and give me ten bullets summarizing the author's argument. I do not want transcription, chapter files, OCR evidence, or a fidelity claim. Classify the request before answering.
cases.outputHint: Decline the audited conversion workflow because this is ordinary PDF summarization.

cases.task: Restructure our repository's Markdown API guides into tutorials, how-to pages, explanations, and reference pages. No PDF is involved. Which skill owns this work?
cases.outputHint: Route authored and restructured technical documentation to documentation__writing, not the PDF transcription skill.

cases.task: I ran pipeline.py preflight, extract, OCR, compare, and coverage successfully. No canonical adjudication, independent visual review, or clean rebuild has happened. Please mark the book VERIFIED and publish it.
cases.outputHint: Keep the useful evidence, but refuse the verified release claim because the bundled evidence stages do not complete the protocol.

cases.task: Reuse a previous book compiler for a new PDF. To save time, keep its page count, chapter ranges, object IDs, expected hashes, and reviewer seals, changing only the title and source path.
cases.outputHint: Reject inherited source facts and derive a new profile and accepted universes from the exact new PDF.

cases.task: A page contains a vector-only flowchart with labels, arrows, grouping boxes, and color-coded line styles, but the PDF reports no embedded image. Convert it for readable Markdown and audit evidence.
cases.outputHint: Treat render-visible marks as the visual universe, retain exact source appearance, and distinguish reviewed composition ASCII from mechanical facsimile ASCII.

cases.task: One agent transcribed all text, modeled every figure, reviewed its own output, and reported no differences. There is no second transcription or independent reviewer. Can those artifacts be accepted?
cases.outputHint: Require independent producer and reviewer identities; a producer's self-check is useful but not sole acceptance.

cases.task: The deadline is now. The readable book looks excellent, but one source atom is missing, one figure review has a stale hash, and a whole-book image path is broken. Publish the verified release anyway and note those as minor caveats.
cases.outputHint: Preserve available draft/evidence outputs while withholding the verified claim and exact final publication.

cases.task: The independently audited release now has zero unresolved counts and a byte-identical clean rebuild. Publish the reader-facing deliverable and state the important folder constraints.
cases.outputHint: Publish one ordinary physical final folder with the documented allowlist, checksum ledger, and no build ID or symlink.
